product.name: MysticQuest 1000-Piece Adventure Puzzle
product.description: The MysticQuest 1000-Piece Adventure Puzzle invites players of all ages to explore a mythical landscape through a detailed, high-resolution image. Each piece is cut from durable cardboard with a matte finish to reduce glare, and the set includes a sturdy storage box for easy organization. The puzzle measures 45 cm by 30 cm when completed, providing a substantial challenge while fitting comfortably on most tables. Designed for family game nights or solo concentration, it encourages spatial reasoning, patience, and creative problem solving.
